subject: Copywriting
title: The Power of 'How To'
description: Learn The Power of 'How To' in one minute.

hook.text: 'How to Win Friends and Influence People' sold 30 million copies. The title did most of the selling.

buildup.text: 'How to' headlines promise transformation. The reader sees where they are and where they could be.

discovery.text: Carnegie tested dozens of titles. The publisher wanted 'The Art of Getting Along.' Carnegie's version won big.

twist.text: 'How to' implies effort. Headlines that promise results without effort—like 'the lazy way'—often win more.

climax.text: The most clicked headline format since 1936: 'How to [get desired result] without [feared obstacle].'

punchline.text: Promise the result, name the fear. 'How to' still wins.

quiz.question: What was the publisher's original proposed title for Dale Carnegie's book?
